meta.title: OmniAgent CRM — Enterprise RAG & Autonomous Support Chatbot

PRD-AI-01.title: OmniAgent Enterprise CRM RAG Master PRD

ARCH-AI-01.title: ADR-004: Hybrid RAG Architecture, Vector DB & CRM Action Tooling

SEC-AI-01.title: Enterprise LLM Safety, PII Redaction & Prompt Injection Standard

nodes.title: Vector Database Deployment & Multi-Tenant Partitioning
nodes.summary: Deploy clustered Qdrant/pgvector instance with HNSW index configuration, tenant-isolated namespaces, and payload filtering.
exit_criteria: Vector search response time < 15ms at 1M vectors
Tenant payload filter strictly enforces collection isolation

dod_evidence: Vector DB cluster benchmarked and healthy in staging

nodes.title: Embedding Pipeline & Semantic Chunking Strategy
nodes.summary: Implement hierarchical chunking (512 tokens with 10% overlap) and batch vectorization using OpenAI text-embedding-3-large / BGE-M3.
exit_criteria: Chunk boundary preserves semantic section headings and markdown tables
Embedding worker handles rate limits with token bucket backoff

dod_evidence: Chunking accuracy and semantic cohesion verified against test corpus

nodes.title: Document Parsing Engine (PDF, HTML, Docx & Knowledge Articles)
nodes.summary: Build high-accuracy document extractor for customer knowledge bases, extracting text, hierarchy, tables, and image captions.
exit_criteria: Extracts structured tables with Markdown format
Corrupted or password-protected documents fail gracefully with detailed error log

dod_evidence: 1,000 synthetic CRM support documents parsed without data loss

nodes.title: Cross-Encoder Semantic Re-ranking Service
nodes.summary: Deploy Cohere Rerank / BGE-Reranker service to re-score top-50 vector candidates down to top-5 most relevant context passages.
exit_criteria: Re-ranking latency < 45ms for 50 candidate passages
NDCG@5 improved by at least 18% over raw vector similarity

nodes.title: Salesforce & HubSpot CRM Connector
nodes.summary: OAuth 2.0 connector for Salesforce (REST/SOQL) and HubSpot API to sync Accounts, Contacts, Deals, and Activity timelines.
exit_criteria: Bi-directional token refresh and automatic reconnect on 401 Unauthorized
Schema mapping converts custom CRM fields to standardized customer entity

dod_evidence: Salesforce Sandbox and HubSpot test portal OAuth sync successful

nodes.title: Zendesk & Freshdesk Support Ticket Ingestion
nodes.summary: Extract resolved ticket conversations, public agent responses, internal macros, and Help Center knowledge base articles.
exit_criteria: Conversations sanitized of internal private notes unless explicit role granted
Resolved solutions vectorized with ticket metadata (tags, product, resolution time)

nodes.title: Incremental CDC Sync & Webhook Event Stream
nodes.summary: Real-time sync listening to CRM webhooks (deal updated, ticket closed, contact created) to update vector store incrementally under 60s.
exit_criteria: Outdated vectors deleted and replaced on document update
Zero redundant full-table scans

nodes.title: PII Masking, DLP & Sanitization Guardrail
nodes.summary: Automatic redaction of SSNs, credit card numbers, passwords, and sensitive health info prior to embedding and LLM prompt forwarding.
exit_criteria: 100% detection rate on standard synthetic PII benchmark (Presidio / regex)
Redacted fields replaced with tokenized placeholders (e.g. `[REDACTED_EMAIL]`)

nodes.title: Hybrid Search Engine (Dense Vectors + Sparse BM25 Fusion)
nodes.summary: Combine dense vector semantic similarity with exact keyword sparse BM25 indexing using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
exit_criteria: Exact part number / error code queries retrieve correct articles in top-1 position
Semantic paraphrased queries achieve Recall@10 > 92%

nodes.title: Contextual Query Rewriter & Multi-Turn Conversation Memory
nodes.summary: Resolve coreferences, pronouns, and implicit context across multi-turn user conversation prior to search query dispatch.
exit_criteria: Follow-up question 'How much does it cost?' rewritten to include the specific product named 3 turns earlier
Sliding memory window discards obsolete tokens without losing entity state

nodes.title: Grounding System, Prompt Assembly & Citations Anchor
nodes.summary: Assemble LLM prompt with retrieved context, system instructions, tone controls, and inline clickable citation markers `[^1]`.
exit_criteria: Every factual statement in LLM response maps to a valid citation source link
Out-of-domain questions gracefully refuse with helpful standard redirection

nodes.title: Hallucination Detector & Real-Time Fact-Checking Guardrail
nodes.summary: Post-generation verification checking generated response against retrieved passages using small fast model / NLI classifier.
exit_criteria: Detects ungrounded fabricated dates, prices, or feature claims with 96% precision
Failed checks trigger automatic regenerated fallback response

nodes.title: Seamless Human Agent Handoff Protocol
nodes.summary: Automatic escalation to human agent queue when sentiment turns negative, confidence drops below threshold, or user requests human.
exit_criteria: Full conversation transcript and AI summary packaged and injected into Zendesk/LiveChat agent window
User notified with live queue position and estimated wait time

nodes.title: Autonomous Function Calling Engine for CRM Actions
nodes.summary: Equip LLM with structured JSON tools: `create_crm_lead()`, `update_ticket_status()`, `schedule_demo()`, `query_account_balance()`.
exit_criteria: Zod schema validation prevents invalid arguments
Tool execution errors handled and reported to LLM for self-correction

nodes.title: Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation Gate for Critical Actions
nodes.summary: Enforce interactive approval modals before executing destructive CRM mutations (e.g. canceling subscriptions, deleting records, refunding).
exit_criteria: Destructive actions blocked in pending state until authenticated confirmation
Audit log records who approved the action with timestamp

nodes.title: Real-Time Sentiment Analysis & High-Value Account Routing
nodes.summary: Analyze user sentiment velocity and cross-reference CRM Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to prioritize VIP account escalations.
exit_criteria: Accounts > $50k ARR with churn risk flagged to Account Executive Slack channel in < 5s
Tone adapted dynamically (more empathetic/concise) based on customer frustration score

nodes.title: Embeddable Chatbot Widget & SIGNAL Design Tokens
nodes.summary: Lightweight (< 40kb gzip) script-tag embeddable chat widget adhering to SIGNAL dark-warm aesthetic (`#0A0B08`, `#CBF23F`).
exit_criteria: Zero CSS bleed into host website DOM via Shadow DOM isolation
Mobile bottom sheet / desktop floating drawer responsiveness verified

dod_evidence: Shadow DOM widget tested cleanly across React, Vue, and vanilla HTML

nodes.title: Streaming Markdown Renderer & Source Citations Drawer
nodes.summary: Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) token stream with syntax-highlighted code blocks, tables, and side drawer for inspected citation sources.
exit_criteria: First token rendered in < 350ms from request dispatch
Clicking citation badge `[^1]` smoothly opens drawer previewing exact knowledge excerpt

nodes.title: Copilot Sidebar Extension for Internal Support Agents
nodes.summary: Chrome Extension / Zendesk App sidebar that auto-suggests RAG responses and CRM actions directly to human support representatives.
exit_criteria: 1-click insert draft response into Zendesk/Intercom reply box
Predicted customer churn and upsell opportunities shown in agent HUD

nodes.title: Interactive Feedback Loop (RLHF Thumbs Up/Down & Flagging)
nodes.summary: Micro-feedback buttons allowing users to rate answer quality, report factual inaccuracy, and provide correction notes.
exit_criteria: Downvoted responses automatically tagged in evaluation dataset for review
Feedback linked with exact generation run ID and prompt trace

nodes.title: LLM Tracing, Token Analytics & OpenLLMetry Pipeline
nodes.summary: Instrument all LLM completions, vector searches, and tool executions with OpenTelemetry / Langfuse trace IDs.
exit_criteria: Full trace includes input tokens, output tokens, latency breakdown, and exact prompt payload
Cost per conversation computed and aggregated in real-time

dod_evidence: Langfuse tracing verified in staging across 500 test chats

nodes.title: Automated RAG Triad Evaluation Pipeline (Ragas)
nodes.summary: Automated CI/CD evaluation running Ragas benchmark for: Context Precision, Faithfulness (Groundedness), and Answer Relevance.
exit_criteria: Faithfulness score >= 0.92 on golden QA dataset
PR blocked if answer relevance drops by > 3%

nodes.title: Token Quota & LLM Cost Allocation Engine
nodes.summary: Enforce monthly token and dollar caps per CRM organization with tiered rate limits and graceful degraded fallback models.
exit_criteria: Tenants hitting 90% quota receive email notification
Hard cap exceeded returns clear HTTP 429 quota exhausted response

nodes.title: Red Teaming & Prompt Injection Vulnerability Testing
nodes.summary: Adversarial test suite simulating direct/indirect prompt injections, system prompt extraction, and jailbreak attempts.
exit_criteria: Zero system prompt leakage across 500 adversarial attack vectors (PyRIT / Garak)
Indirect prompt injection inside CRM documents intercepted before tool execution

nodes.title: Staging Deployment & Multi-Tenant Concurrency Benchmarking
nodes.summary: Deploy complete RAG pipeline to Staging and execute Locust load test simulating 500 concurrent customer chats.
exit_criteria: p95 end-to-end response latency < 1.8s under peak concurrency
Zero 500 Internal Server Errors or connection pool exhaustions

nodes.title: Zero-Downtime Production Deployment & SLA Monitoring
nodes.summary: Production launch across multi-region ECS/Kubernetes with automated healthchecks, fallback LLM providers, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
exit_criteria: Automatic fallback to backup LLM provider (Azure OpenAI -> Anthropic) on provider outage
Live error budget alerts configured in Datadog / PagerDuty

nodes.title: GDPR Right-to-be-Forgotten & Vector Purge Engine
nodes.summary: Automated workflow to hard-delete customer records, associated embedding chunks, and conversation transcripts upon GDPR DSAR request.
exit_criteria: User vector records purged across all collections in < 10 seconds
Audit certificate of deletion generated for compliance records
